Automation: Reviewed native action · rules reference

Your hand snaps out beneath the falling bottle, catching it before it shatters on the stones.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One falling, unattended item in your square or an adjacent square, within reach, before it lands or falls out of reach.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Purchase once; each use spends your Reaction.
Type
Utility

Catch the item in a free hand. The item must be small enough to hold in that hand. The ability catches falling objects; attacks and items held by another creature follow their own rules.

Additional rulings
